description:
Capability for the main window of the EXPERIMENTAL Tauri build (spec 016,
issue #780). The single custom `refract_request` command needs no explicit permission here --
app-defined commands are callable from every window by default (security/capabilities.mdx).
Capabilities gate webview-to-plugin calls only: Rust-side plugin calls (`repositories.
pickFolder`'s `app.dialog()`, `clipboard.writeText`'s `app.clipboard()`, and lane R10b's own
`shell::notifications` OS-notification-on-session-status / `tauri_plugin_single_instance::init`
second-launch focus, issue #793 -- both driven entirely from Rust, the renderer never calls
either plugin) need no permission here regardless of what this file grants, so this only covers
what the renderer itself may invoke directly.

The security baseline's external-link policy (issue #793: "only http and https through the
opener plugin") is a SCOPED `opener:allow-open-url` grant below, restricted to those two schemes
-- narrower than the plugin's own `opener:default`/`allow-default-urls` bundles (which also admit
`mailto:`/`tel:` and the unscoped `reveal_item_in_dir`). `src/tauri-bridge/entry.ts`'s injected
`_blank`-link click handler (`externalLinks.ts`) is the one caller. `core:default` is the baseline
window/app/event permission set every Tauri window needs.
